Question B-001-006-003.

Why the correct answer is right: Using an amateur amplifier to boost a licence-exempt transmitter is not permitted.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "When emissions will be outside amateur radio frequency allocations": Operating outside amateur allocations makes the idea worse, not permissible.
- sourceIndex 2: "Only for short test transmissions": A short test does not authorize amplification of licence-exempt equipment.
- sourceIndex 3: "When other users will not be interfered with": Lack of interference does not create permission for the prohibited amplifier use.
